text: The double negation modality ¬¬ in HoTT is:
choices: A modality with modal types = all propositions
A modality with modal types = classical propositions (double-negation-stable propositions)
A modality with modal types = sets
explanation: ¬¬ is a modality; ¬¬-modal types are propositions P with P ↔ ¬¬P (double-negation-stable).
